newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER SHOWCASE-REAL CRUSH ATLETICO TO CLINCH SPANISH CROWN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-REAL CRUSH ATLETICO TO CLINCH SPANISH CROWN.

text.p: Real Madrid achieved their 27th Spanish league title in fine style on Saturday with an impressive 3-1 victory over reigning champions Atletico Madrid.
Needing just a point, Real tore their neighbours apart with first half goals from Raul Gonzalez and Fernando Hierro. Predrag Mijatovic added the third shortly after the break.
When Juan Eduardo Esnaider pulled one back for the visitors Real had to weather 10 minutes of heavy pressure before running out easy winners.
